dialogues.speaker: Diotima
dialogues.text: Are you new here? Don't be nervous. The fact that you can understand me means nothing went wrong during the "Uplifting" process.

dialogues.speaker: Diotima
dialogues.text: I'm Diotima of Meropis, one of the very first inhabitants here. When I arrived, there were no collections of books, only a desolate wilderness.

dialogues.speaker: Diotima
dialogues.text: Back then, I was a boatman, responsible for sending wandering souls onto the silver shining ships, bound for the Moon Capital above the clouds.

dialogues.speaker: Diotima
dialogues.text: Come to think of it, it's not much different from what I do now.

dialogues.speaker: Diotima
dialogues.text: That's good. If anything comes up, feel free to reach out to me anytime.

dialogues.speaker: Diotima
dialogues.text: Ah... I suppose people nowadays wouldn't know. In my time, three bright moons still hung in the sky, and upon each resided many lunar envoys.

dialogues.speaker: Diotima
dialogues.text: Back then, noble souls did not head for the depths of the ancient tree. Instead, they followed the trail of the envoys to sleep eternally in the cities upon the moons.

dialogues.speaker: Diotima
dialogues.text: I never actually visited the moons myself, but it must be a place as peaceful as it is here.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: And what do you do now?

dialogues.speaker: Diotima
dialogues.text: I wouldn't call it a "job," it's more like work I found to feed myself. As an old-timer who's lived here so long, I provide guidance to the newcomers who have just arrived.

dialogues.speaker: Diotima
dialogues.text: But once you've settled into life here, you're unlikely to run into any real trouble. After all, whether you are wealthy or poor, it makes no difference here.
